# Generated by "Claude files/tools/build_goblin_boomworks.py" from goblin_data.py. Change the tables there and re-run.

# Plain ifs only: no else in these effects (Claude files/35). Country scope unless said otherwise.

# ---- Small pieces ----
# -1,000 manpower, none with Designated Survivors.
DA_GB_lose_manpower = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Survivors } }
		add_manpower = -1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Survivors }
		custom_tooltip = DA_GB_survivors_saved_tt
	}
}
# Province scope: a Blast Crater (five years, half with the Lab at level V); a new one restarts the old one.
DA_GB_make_crater = {
	remove_province_modifier = DA_GB_crater
	if = {
		limit = { owner = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_lab value = 5 } } }
		add_province_modifier = { name = DA_GB_crater duration = 913 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { owner = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_lab value = 5 } } } }
		add_province_modifier = { name = DA_GB_crater duration = 1825 }
	}
}
DA_GB_make_lab_hole = {
	add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GB_lab_hole duration = 730 }
}
DA_GB_advisor_vanishes = {
	if = {
		limit = { employed_advisor = { category = DIP } }
		custom_tooltip = DA_GB_advisor_gone_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			remove_advisor = statesman
			remove_advisor = naval_reformer
			remove_advisor = trader
			remove_advisor = spymaster
			remove_advisor = colonial_governor
			remove_advisor = diplomat
			remove_advisor = navigator
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { employed_advisor = { category = DIP } } }
		add_prestige = -10
	}
}
# It regulates the wrong way: every running invention +20 pressure.

DA_GB_cap_pressure = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_$g$ value = 100 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_$g$ value = 100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_$g$ value = 0 } } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_$g$ value = 0 }
	}
}
# The zone flags of a gauge from its pressure: Cool below 40, Hot below 80, then the red.
DA_GB_zone = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.$g$
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_red.$g$
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_$g$ value = 80 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_red.$g$
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_$g$ value = 40 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_$g$ value = 80 } } }
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.$g$
	}
}
DA_GB_wzone = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.$g$
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.$g$
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_$g$ value = 80 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.$g$
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_$g$ value = 40 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_$g$ value = 80 } } }
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.$g$
	}
}
# A valve: $v$ is vc (the Cool line), vh (the Hot line) or voff.
DA_GB_set_valve = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_vc.$g$
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_vh.$g$
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_voff.$g$
	set_country_flag = DA_GB_$v$.$g$
}
DA_GB_set_wvalve = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_wvc.$g$
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_wvh.$g$
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_wvoff.$g$
	set_country_flag = DA_GB_$v$.$g$
}

# ---- Research (doc 64, section 3) ----
# The running research moves back by $share$ of its target, never below 0 (Padded Rooms: 25% less, by its zone).
DA_GB_setback = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_in_progress check_variable = { which = DA_research_progress_MAX value = 0.001 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_dp which = DA_research_progress_MAX }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_dp value = -$share$ }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.padded NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.padded } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.padded } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_dp value = 0.75 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.padded has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.padded }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_dp value = 0.625 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.padded has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.padded }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_dp value = 0.5 }
		}
		change_variable = { which = DA_research_progress which = DA_GB_dp }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_research_progress value = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_research_progress value = 0 }
		}
		DA_GB_research_percent = yes
	}
}
DA_GB_advance = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_in_progress check_variable = { which = DA_research_progress_MAX value = 0.001 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_dp which = DA_research_progress_MAX }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_dp value = $share$ }
		change_variable = { which = DA_research_progress which = DA_GB_dp }
		DA_GB_research_percent = yes
	}
}
DA_GB_research_percent = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_research_progress_percent which = DA_research_progress }
	divide_variable = { which = DA_research_progress_percent which = DA_research_progress_MAX }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_research_progress_percent value = 100 }
}
# DA_monthly_research_tick (a marked DA_GB line): the push multiplies the month's progress after every other research
# modifier, then the month's lab accident is rolled. Players only: the AI gets its accident at the end (DA_GB_research_done).
DA_GB_push_research = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom ai = no }
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_push value = 1 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_research_speed_gain_var value = 1.333 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_push value = 2 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_research_speed_gain_var value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_push value = 0 } }
			random_list = {
				5 = {
					modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
					modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
					modifier = { factor = 0.85 has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.blastwalls NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.blastwalls } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.blastwalls } }
					modifier = { factor = 0.775 has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.blastwalls has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.blastwalls }
					modifier = { factor = 0.7 has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.blastwalls has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.blastwalls }
					modifier = { factor = 1.25 DA_GB_angry = yes }
					DA_GB_accident = yes
				}
				995 = {
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_push value = 1 } }
			random_list = {
				15 = {
					modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
					modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
					modifier = { factor = 0.85 has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.blastwalls NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.blastwalls } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.blastwalls } }
					modifier = { factor = 0.775 has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.blastwalls has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.blastwalls }
					modifier = { factor = 0.7 has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.blastwalls has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.blastwalls }
					modifier = { factor = 1.25 DA_GB_angry = yes }
					DA_GB_accident = yes
				}
				985 = {
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_push value = 2 } }
			random_list = {
				60 = {
					modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
					modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
					modifier = { factor = 0.85 has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.blastwalls NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.blastwalls } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.blastwalls } }
					modifier = { factor = 0.775 has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.blastwalls has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.blastwalls }
					modifier = { factor = 0.7 has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.blastwalls has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.blastwalls }
					modifier = { factor = 1.25 DA_GB_angry = yes }
					DA_GB_accident = yes
				}
				940 = {
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
# A lab accident (players): the outcome now, then its report (DA_GB_event.21-24).
DA_GB_accident = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Controlled } }
		random_list = {
			400 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc_last value = 1 }
				DA_GB_log = { code = 1 }
				DA_GB_setback = { share = 0.1 }
				if = {
					limit = { ai = no }
					country_event = { id = DA_GB_event.21 }
				}
			}
			350 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc_last value = 2 }
				DA_GB_log = { code = 2 }
				DA_GB_setback = { share = 0.2 }
				capital_scope = { DA_GB_make_crater = yes add_devastation = 10 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses }
					add_estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses loyalty = -5 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { ai = no }
					country_event = { id = DA_GB_event.22 }
				}
			}
			100 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc_last value = 3 }
				DA_GB_log = { code = 3 }
				DA_GB_setback = { share = 0.4 }
				capital_scope = { DA_GB_make_crater = yes add_devastation = 20 }
				add_prestige = -10
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Survivors } }
					DA_GB_make_lab_hole = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses }
					add_estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses loyalty = -5 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { ai = no }
					country_event = { id = DA_GB_event.23 }
				}
			}
			150 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc_last value = 4 }
				DA_GB_log = { code = 4 }
				DA_GB_advance = { share = 0.1 }
				change_innovativeness = 2
				if = {
					limit = { has_estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses }
					add_estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses loyalty = 5 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { ai = no }
					country_event = { id = DA_GB_event.24 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Controlled }
		random_list = {
			235 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc_last value = 1 }
				DA_GB_log = { code = 1 }
				DA_GB_setback = { share = 0.1 }
				if = {
					limit = { ai = no }
					country_event = { id = DA_GB_event.21 }
				}
			}
			206 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc_last value = 2 }
				DA_GB_log = { code = 2 }
				DA_GB_setback = { share = 0.2 }
				capital_scope = { DA_GB_make_crater = yes add_devastation = 10 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses }
					add_estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses loyalty = -5 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { ai = no }
					country_event = { id = DA_GB_event.22 }
				}
			}
			59 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc_last value = 3 }
				DA_GB_log = { code = 3 }
				DA_GB_setback = { share = 0.4 }
				capital_scope = { DA_GB_make_crater = yes add_devastation = 20 }
				add_prestige = -10
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Survivors } }
					DA_GB_make_lab_hole = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses }
					add_estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses loyalty = -5 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { ai = no }
					country_event = { id = DA_GB_event.23 }
				}
			}
			500 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc_last value = 4 }
				DA_GB_log = { code = 4 }
				DA_GB_advance = { share = 0.1 }
				change_innovativeness = 2
				if = {
					limit = { has_estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses }
					add_estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses loyalty = 5 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { ai = no }
					country_event = { id = DA_GB_event.24 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	DA_GB_refresh = yes
}
# The logbook of the Lab page: the last three accidents (1-4, ACCIDENTS), the newest first.
DA_GB_log = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_GB_log3 which = DA_GB_log2 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_GB_log2 which = DA_GB_log1 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_GB_log1 value = $code$ }
}
# DA_General_Research_events.3 (a marked DA_GB line): a research has ended. Eureka for a player; for the AI, one
# accident in 4 with damage only.
DA_GB_research_done = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom ai = no }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GB_eureka_hit
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_genius_ready }
			clr_country_flag = DA_GB_genius_ready
			clr_country_flag = DA_GB_genius_used
			set_country_flag = DA_GB_genius_used
			set_country_flag = DA_GB_eureka_hit
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_push value = 0 } }
			random = { chance = 5 set_country_flag = DA_GB_eureka_hit }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_push value = 1 } }
			random = { chance = 10 set_country_flag = DA_GB_eureka_hit }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_push value = 2 } }
			random = { chance = 15 set_country_flag = DA_GB_eureka_hit }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Bounty }
			random = { chance = 5 set_country_flag = DA_GB_eureka_hit }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.sparks NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.sparks } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.sparks } }
			random = { chance = 3 set_country_flag = DA_GB_eureka_hit }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.sparks has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.sparks }
			random = { chance = 5 set_country_flag = DA_GB_eureka_hit }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.sparks has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.sparks }
			random = { chance = 6 set_country_flag = DA_GB_eureka_hit }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_eureka_hit }
			change_innovativeness = 3
			set_country_flag = DA_GB_spark
			country_event = { id = DA_GB_event.25 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom ai = yes }
		random = { chance = 25 capital_scope = { DA_GB_make_crater = yes add_devastation = 10 } }
	}
}
# DA_start_research (a marked DA_GB line): a Spark starts the research 15% done.
DA_GB_apply_spark = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_spark }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GB_spark
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_dp which = DA_research_progress_MAX }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_dp value = 0.15 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_research_progress which = DA_GB_dp }
		DA_GB_research_percent = yes
	}
}
# The push (button effects: all hidden, the plates and the P&R button have their own tooltips).
DA_GB_set_push = {
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_push value = $n$ }
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_push_set
		DA_GB_refresh = yes
	}
}
# The P&R switch: Book, Hurry, MORE (with I Said More), Book...
DA_GB_cycle_push = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_push value = 0 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_push_next value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_push value = 1 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_push_next value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_More }
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_push_next value = 2 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_push value = 2 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_push_next value = 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_push which = DA_GB_push_next }
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_push_set
		DA_GB_refresh = yes
	}
}

DA_GB_rent_gnome = {
	add_treasury = -300
	custom_tooltip = DA_GB_rent_gnome_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		clr_country_flag = DA_GB_gnome
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_gnome
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_gnome_ever } }
			set_country_flag = DA_GB_gnome_ever
			decrease_monstrous_2 = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_ally = { DA_RH_primary_gnomish = yes } }
			random_ally = { limit = { DA_RH_primary_gnomish = yes } add_treasury = 150 }
		}
		DA_GB_refresh = yes
	}
}

# ---- The inventions (doc 64, section 4) ----
# The privilege hooks: DA_GB_on.<id> while it runs (on_granted; on_revoked and on_invalid clear it).
DA_GB_inv_granted = {
	hidden_effect = {
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_on.$inv$
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_built.$inv$
		DA_GB_refresh = yes
	}
}
DA_GB_inv_removed = {
	hidden_effect = {
		clr_country_flag = DA_GB_on.$inv$
		clr_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.$inv$
		clr_country_flag = DA_GB_red.$inv$
		DA_GB_refresh = yes
	}
}

	custom_tooltip = DA_GB_build_tt.borers
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_borers value = 0 }
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_built.borers
		if = { limit = { ai = yes } DA_GB_set_valve = { g = borers v = vh } }
		set_estate_privilege = DA_GB_inv_borers
	}
}
DA_GB_repair.borers = {
	add_treasury = -150
	custom_tooltip = DA_GB_repair_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		clr_country_flag = DA_GB_broken.borers
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_borers value = 0 }
		set_estate_privilege = DA_GB_inv_borers
	}
}
DA_GB_switch_on.borers = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_GB_switch_on_tt
	hidden_effect = { set_estate_privilege = DA_GB_inv_borers }
}
DA_GB_switch_off.borers = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_GB_switch_off_tt
	hidden_effect = { remove_estate_privilege = DA_GB_inv_borers }
}
DA_GB_vent.borers = {
	add_treasury = -50
	custom_tooltip = DA_GB_vent_tt
	hidden_effect = { DA_GB_vent_down = { g = borers } }
}

	add_treasury = -500

	hidden_effect = {

		if = { limit = { ai = yes } DA_GB_set_valve = { g = pots v = vh } }

DA_GB_vent.machines = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_GB_vent_tt
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_mvol value = 1 } }
		add_treasury = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_mvol value = 2 } }
		add_treasury = -50
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_mvol value = 3 } }
		add_treasury = -75
	}
	hidden_effect = { DA_GB_vent_down = { g = machines } }
}
DA_GB_vent_down = {
	change_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_$g$ value = -40 }
	DA_GB_cap_pressure = { g = $g$ }
	DA_GB_zone = { g = $g$ }
	DA_GB_refresh = yes
}
DA_GB_wvent_down = {
	change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_$g$ value = -40 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_$g$ value = 0 } } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_$g$ value = 0 }
	}
	DA_GB_wzone = { g = $g$ }
	DA_GB_refresh = yes
}
# The buttons of the right panel act on the selected slot (DA_GB_sel).
DA_GB_sel_build = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 1 } }
		DA_GB_build.stills = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 2 } }
		DA_GB_build.pumps = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 3 } }
		DA_GB_build.market = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 4 } }
		DA_GB_build.conveyor = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 5 } }
		DA_GB_build.smog = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 6 } }
		DA_GB_build.quarries = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 7 } }
		DA_GB_build.rumour = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 8 } }
		DA_GB_build.telegraph = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 9 } }
		DA_GB_build.lectures = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 10 } }
		DA_GB_build.clock = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 11 } }
		DA_GB_build.stealth = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 12 } }
		DA_GB_build.organ = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 13 } }
		DA_GB_build.walls = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 14 } }
		DA_GB_build.mills = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 15 } }
		DA_GB_build.borers = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 16 } }
		DA_GB_build.pots = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 17 } }
		DA_GB_build.wasp = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 19 } }
		DA_GB_build.blastwalls = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 20 } }
		DA_GB_build.sparks = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 21 } }
		DA_GB_build.padded = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 22 } }
		DA_GB_build.dynamo = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 23 } }
		DA_GB_build.regulator = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 24 } }
		DA_GB_build.engine = yes
	}
}

		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 23 } }
		DA_GB_switch_on.regulator = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 24 } }
		DA_GB_switch_on.engine = yes
	}
}

# ---- The monthly pass of the gauges (on_monthly_pulse) ----
DA_GB_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
		DA_GB_gauge.stills = yes
		DA_GB_gauge.pumps = yes
		DA_GB_gauge.market = yes
		DA_GB_gauge.conveyor = yes
		DA_GB_gauge.smog = yes
		DA_GB_gauge.quarries = yes
		DA_GB_gauge.rumour = yes
		DA_GB_gauge.telegraph = yes
		DA_GB_gauge.lectures = yes
		DA_GB_gauge.clock = yes
		DA_GB_gauge.stealth = yes
		DA_GB_gauge.organ = yes
		DA_GB_gauge.walls = yes
		DA_GB_gauge.mills = yes
		DA_GB_gauge.borers = yes
		DA_GB_gauge.pots = yes
		DA_GB_gauge.wasp = yes
		DA_GB_gauge.blastwalls = yes
		DA_GB_gauge.sparks = yes
		DA_GB_gauge.padded = yes
		DA_GB_gauge.dynamo = yes
		DA_GB_gauge.regulator = yes
		DA_GB_gauge.engine = yes
		DA_GB_gauge_machines = yes
		DA_GB_wgauge.MF = yes
		DA_GB_wgauge.TV = yes
		DA_GB_wgauge.AC = yes
		DA_GB_wgauge.DW = yes
		DA_GB_wgauge.SH = yes
		DA_GB_wgauge.DL = yes
		DA_GB_wgauge.RW = yes
		DA_GB_wgauge.EW = yes
		DA_GB_wgauge.ES = yes
		DA_GB_wgauge.FF = yes
		DA_GB_wgauge.OT = yes
		DA_GB_wgauge.BG = yes
		DA_GB_wgauge.ST = yes
		DA_GB_wgauge.SL = yes
		DA_GB_wgauge.MV = yes
		DA_GB_wgauge.HV = yes
		DA_GB_refresh = yes
	}
}
DA_GB_gauge.stills = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.stills check_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_stills value = 100 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
		DA_GB_mishap.stills = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.stills NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_blew } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_tuned.stills }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 0.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.regulator }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 0.85 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_GB_angry = yes }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1.25 }
		}
		change_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_stills which = DA_GB_rate }
		DA_GB_cap_pressure = { g = stills }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_vc.stills check_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_stills value = 40 } treasury = 25 }
			add_treasury = -25
			change_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_stills value = -40 }
		}
		if = {

	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.dynamo check_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_dynamo value = 100 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
		DA_GB_mishap.dynamo = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.dynamo NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_blew } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_tuned.dynamo }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 0.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.regulator }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 0.85 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_GB_angry = yes }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1.25 }
		}
		change_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_dynamo which = DA_GB_rate }
		DA_GB_cap_pressure = { g = dynamo }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_vc.dynamo check_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_dynamo value = 40 } treasury = 50 }
			add_treasury = -50
			change_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_dynamo value = -40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_vh.dynamo check_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_dynamo value = 80 } treasury = 50 }
			add_treasury = -50
			change_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_dynamo value = -40 }
		}
		DA_GB_cap_pressure = { g = dynamo }
		DA_GB_zone = { g = dynamo }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_dynamo value = 100 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.dynamo } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.dynamo } }
				random_list = {
					1 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_mishap.dynamo = yes
					}
					999 = {
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.dynamo }
				random_list = {
					10 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_mishap.dynamo = yes
					}
					990 = {
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.dynamo }
				random_list = {
					30 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_mishap.dynamo = yes
					}
					970 = {
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.dynamo NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.dynamo } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_broken.dynamo } check_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_dynamo value = 0.001 } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_dynamo value = -5 }
		DA_GB_cap_pressure = { g = dynamo }
		DA_GB_zone = { g = dynamo }
	}
}

DA_GB_gauge_machines = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_mvol value = 1 } check_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_machines value = 100 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
		DA_GB_mishap.machines = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_mvol value = 1 } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_blew } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate which = DA_GB_mvol }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_tuned.machines }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 0.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.regulator }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 0.85 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_GB_angry = yes }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1.25 }
		}
		change_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_machines which = DA_GB_rate }
		DA_GB_cap_pressure = { g = machines }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_vc.machines check_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_machines value = 40 } DA_GB_machines_vent_price = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_mvol value = 1 } }
				add_treasury = -25
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_mvol value = 2 } }
				add_treasury = -50
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_mvol value = 3 } }
				add_treasury = -75
			}
			change_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_machines value = -40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_vh.machines check_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_machines value = 80 } DA_GB_machines_vent_price = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_mvol value = 1 } }
				add_treasury = -25
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_mvol value = 2 } }
				add_treasury = -50
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_mvol value = 3 } }
				add_treasury = -75
			}
			change_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_machines value = -40 }
		}
		DA_GB_cap_pressure = { g = machines }
		DA_GB_zone = { g = machines }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_machines value = 100 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.machines } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.machines } }
				random_list = {
					1 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_mishap.machines = yes
					}
					999 = {
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.machines }
				random_list = {
					10 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_mishap.machines = yes
					}
					990 = {
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.machines }
				random_list = {
					30 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_mishap.machines = yes
					}
					970 = {
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_mvol value = 1 } } check_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_machines value = 0.001 } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_machines value = -5 }
		DA_GB_cap_pressure = { g = machines }
		DA_GB_zone = { g = machines }
	}
}

# ---- Mishaps (doc 64, section 4.3): the outcome now, then the report (DA_GB_event.41-48) ----
DA_GB_mishap.stills = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Controlled } }
		random_list = {
			450 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_stills value = 0 }
				set_country_flag = DA_GB_broken.stills
				remove_estate_privilege = DA_GB_inv_stills
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 1 }
				DA_GB_zone = { g = stills }
			}
			350 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_stills value = 0 }
				set_country_flag = DA_GB_broken.stills
				remove_estate_privilege = DA_GB_inv_stills
				random_owned_province = { add_devastation = 15 }
				random_owned_province = { DA_GB_make_crater = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { has_estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses }
					add_estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses loyalty = -5 }
				}
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 2 }
				DA_GB_zone = { g = stills }
			}
			150 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_stills value = 0 }
				change_innovativeness = 3
				DA_GB_advance = { share = 0.05 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses }
					add_estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses loyalty = 5 }
				}
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 3 }
				DA_GB_zone = { g = stills }
			}
			50 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_stills value = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_tuned.stills }
					change_innovativeness = 3
					DA_GB_advance = { share = 0.05 }
					if = {
						limit = { has_estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses }
						add_estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses loyalty = 5 }
					}
					set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 3 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_tuned.stills } }
					set_country_flag = DA_GB_tuned.stills
					set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 4 }
				}
				DA_GB_zone = { g = stills }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Controlled }
		random_list = {
			265 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep value = 1 }

				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 1 }
				DA_GB_zone = { g = stills }
			}
			206 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_stills value = 0 }
				set_country_flag = DA_GB_broken.stills
				remove_estate_privilege = DA_GB_inv_stills
				random_owned_province = { add_devastation = 15 }

				}
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 2 }
				DA_GB_zone = { g = stills }

				change_innovativeness = 3
				DA_GB_advance = { share = 0.05 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses }

					add_estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses loyalty = -5 }
				}
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 6 }
				DA_GB_zone = { g = machines }
			}
			500 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep value = 18 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_machines value = 0 }
				change_innovativeness = 3
				DA_GB_advance = { share = 0.05 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses }
					add_estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses loyalty = 5 }
				}
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 7 }
				DA_GB_zone = { g = machines }
			}
			29 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep value = 18 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_p_machines value = 0 }
				change_innovativeness = 3
				DA_GB_advance = { share = 0.05 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses }
					add_estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses loyalty = 5 }
				}
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 8 }
				DA_GB_zone = { g = machines }
			}
		}
	}
	DA_GB_report = yes
}
# The report of a mishap (players): DA_GB_rep the slot (1-24) or the wonder (101-116), DA_GB_rep_kind the outcome.
DA_GB_report = {
	if = {
		limit = { ai = no }
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 1 } }
			country_event = { id = DA_GB_event.41 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 2 } }
			country_event = { id = DA_GB_event.42 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 3 } }
			country_event = { id = DA_GB_event.43 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 4 } }
			country_event = { id = DA_GB_event.44 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 5 } }
			country_event = { id = DA_GB_event.45 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 6 } }
			country_event = { id = DA_GB_event.46 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 7 } }
			country_event = { id = DA_GB_event.47 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 8 } }
			country_event = { id = DA_GB_event.48 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 11 } }
			country_event = { id = DA_GB_event.51 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 12 } }
			country_event = { id = DA_GB_event.52 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 13 } }
			country_event = { id = DA_GB_event.53 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 14 } }
			country_event = { id = DA_GB_event.54 }
		}
	}
}

# ---- War Machines (doc 64, section 8): the volatility is the number of unstable classes, at most 3 ----
DA_GB_machines_count = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_GB_mvol value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_jury_rigging OR = { has_country_modifier = DA_Unique_mod.BLUEPRINT.INFAN.GB_shoddy has_country_modifier = DA_Unique_mod.RUNE.INFAN.GB_scribbled } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GB_mvol value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_jury_rigging OR = { has_country_modifier = DA_Unique_mod.BLUEPRINT.CAVAL.GB_shoddy has_country_modifier = DA_Unique_mod.RUNE.CAVAL.GB_scribbled } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GB_mvol value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_jury_rigging OR = { has_country_modifier = DA_Unique_mod.BLUEPRINT.ARTIL.GB_shoddy has_country_modifier = DA_Unique_mod.RUNE.ARTIL.GB_scribbled } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GB_mvol value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_jury_rigging OR = { has_country_modifier = DA_Unique_mod.BLUEPRINT.ARTIFICER.GB_shoddy has_country_modifier = DA_Unique_mod.RUNE.ARTIFICER.GB_scribbled } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GB_mvol value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_mvol value = 3 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_mvol value = 3 }
	}
}

		set_country_flag = DA_GB_rigging.MF

DA_GB_rig_done.MF = {
	if = {
		limit = { owns = 4039 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_t1.MF }
			4039 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Magma_Forge tier = 1 } set_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_1 }
			DA_FG_sync = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_t2.MF }
			4039 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Magma_Forge tier = 1 } set_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 }
			DA_FG_sync = yes
		}
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MF value = 0 }
		DA_GB_wzone = { g = MF }
	}
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_rigging.MF
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_t1.MF
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_t2.MF
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_busy
	DA_GB_refresh = yes
}

DA_GB_wgauge.MF = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_w_rigged.MF = yes check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MF value = 100 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
		DA_GB_wmishap.MF = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_w_rigged.MF = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_blew } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { 4039 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_1 } } change_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { 4039 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } change_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.regulator }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 0.85 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_GB_angry = yes }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1.25 }
		}
		change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MF which = DA_GB_rate }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MF value = 100 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MF value = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MF value = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MF value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wvc.MF check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MF value = 40 } DA_GB_wvent_price.MF = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { 4039 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } }
				add_treasury = -100
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { 4039 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } }
				add_treasury = -50
			}
			change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MF value = -40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wvh.MF check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MF value = 80 } DA_GB_wvent_price.MF = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { 4039 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } }
				add_treasury = -100
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { 4039 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } }
				add_treasury = -50
			}
			change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MF value = -40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MF value = 100 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MF value = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MF value = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MF value = 0 }
		}
		DA_GB_wzone = { g = MF }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MF value = 100 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.MF } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.MF } }
				random_list = {
					1 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.MF = yes
					}
					999 = {
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.MF }
				random_list = {
					10 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.MF = yes
					}
					990 = {
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.MF }
				random_list = {
					30 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.MF = yes
					}
					970 = {
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			500 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep value = 101 }

				DA_GB_wzone = { g = MF }
			}

				if = {
					limit = { has_estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses }

					4039 = { clr_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_1 add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Magma_Forge tier = -1 } }
				}
				clr_country_flag = DA_GB_fell
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 14 }
				DA_GB_wzone = { g = MF }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Controlled }
		random_list = {
			294 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep value = 101 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MF value = 0 }
				4039 = { add_devastation = 15 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 11 }
				DA_GB_wzone = { g = MF }
			}
			206 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep value = 101 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MF value = 0 }
				4039 = { add_devastation = 15 }
				4039 = { DA_GB_make_crater = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { has_estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses }

				}
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 12 }

DA_GB_wgauge.AC = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_w_rigged.AC = yes check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_AC value = 100 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
		DA_GB_wmishap.AC = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_w_rigged.AC = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_blew } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { 4284 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_1 } } change_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { 4284 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } change_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.regulator }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 0.85 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_GB_angry = yes }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1.25 }
		}
		change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_AC which = DA_GB_rate }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_AC value = 100 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_AC value = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_AC value = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_AC value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wvc.AC check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_AC value = 40 } DA_GB_wvent_price.AC = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { 4284 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } }
				add_treasury = -100
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { 4284 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } }
				add_treasury = -50
			}
			change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_AC value = -40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wvh.AC check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_AC value = 80 } DA_GB_wvent_price.AC = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { 4284 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } }
				add_treasury = -100
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { 4284 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } }
				add_treasury = -50
			}
			change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_AC value = -40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_AC value = 100 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_AC value = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_AC value = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_AC value = 0 }
		}
		DA_GB_wzone = { g = AC }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_AC value = 100 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.AC } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.AC } }
				random_list = {
					1 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.AC = yes
					}
					999 = {
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.AC }
				random_list = {
					10 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.AC = yes
					}
					990 = {
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.AC }
				random_list = {
					30 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.AC = yes
					}
					970 = {

				}
			}

DA_GB_wgauge.SH = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_w_rigged.SH = yes check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_SH value = 100 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
		DA_GB_wmishap.SH = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_w_rigged.SH = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_blew } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { 4020 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_1 } } change_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { 4020 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } change_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.regulator }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 0.85 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_GB_angry = yes }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1.25 }
		}
		change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_SH which = DA_GB_rate }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_SH value = 100 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_SH value = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_SH value = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_SH value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wvc.SH check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_SH value = 40 } DA_GB_wvent_price.SH = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { 4020 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } }
				add_treasury = -100
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { 4020 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } }
				add_treasury = -50
			}
			change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_SH value = -40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wvh.SH check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_SH value = 80 } DA_GB_wvent_price.SH = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { 4020 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } }
				add_treasury = -100
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { 4020 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } }
				add_treasury = -50
			}
			change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_SH value = -40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_SH value = 100 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_SH value = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_SH value = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_SH value = 0 }
		}
		DA_GB_wzone = { g = SH }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_SH value = 100 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.SH } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.SH } }
				random_list = {
					1 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.SH = yes
					}
					999 = {
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.SH }
				random_list = {
					10 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.SH = yes
					}
					990 = {
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.SH }
				random_list = {
					30 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.SH = yes
					}
					970 = {
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

DA_GB_rig_done.RW = {
	if = {
		limit = { owns = 2931 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_t1.RW }
			2931 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Railway_HQ tier = 1 } set_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_1 }
			DA_RW_recount = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_t2.RW }
			2931 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Railway_HQ tier = 1 } set_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 }
			DA_RW_recount = yes
		}
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_RW value = 0 }
		DA_GB_wzone = { g = RW }
	}
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_rigging.RW
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_t1.RW
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_t2.RW
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_busy
	DA_GB_refresh = yes
}
DA_GB_wvent.RW = {
	if = {
		limit = { 2931 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } }
		add_treasury = -100
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { 2931 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } }
		add_treasury = -50
	}
	custom_tooltip = DA_GB_vent_tt
	hidden_effect = { DA_GB_wvent_down = { g = RW } }
}
DA_GB_wgauge.RW = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_w_rigged.RW = yes check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_RW value = 100 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
		DA_GB_wmishap.RW = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_w_rigged.RW = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_blew } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { 2931 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_1 } } change_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { 2931 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } change_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.regulator }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 0.85 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_GB_angry = yes }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1.25 }
		}
		change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_RW which = DA_GB_rate }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_RW value = 100 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_RW value = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_RW value = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_RW value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wvc.RW check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_RW value = 40 } DA_GB_wvent_price.RW = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { 2931 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } }
				add_treasury = -100
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { 2931 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } }
				add_treasury = -50
			}
			change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_RW value = -40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wvh.RW check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_RW value = 80 } DA_GB_wvent_price.RW = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { 2931 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } }
				add_treasury = -100
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { 2931 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } }
				add_treasury = -50
			}
			change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_RW value = -40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_RW value = 100 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_RW value = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_RW value = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_RW value = 0 }
		}
		DA_GB_wzone = { g = RW }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_RW value = 100 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.RW } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.RW } }
				random_list = {
					1 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.RW = yes
					}
					999 = {
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.RW }
				random_list = {
					10 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.RW = yes
					}
					990 = {
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.RW }
				random_list = {
					30 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.RW = yes
					}
					970 = {
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

DA_GB_rig_done.ES = {
	if = {
		limit = { owns = 4247 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_t1.ES }
			4247 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Earth_Shatterer tier = 1 } set_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_t2.ES }
			4247 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Earth_Shatterer tier = 1 } set_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 }
		}
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ES value = 0 }
		DA_GB_wzone = { g = ES }
	}
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_rigging.ES
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_t1.ES
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_t2.ES
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_busy
	DA_GB_refresh = yes
}
DA_GB_wvent.ES = {

	}

		add_treasury = -50

	custom_tooltip = DA_GB_vent_tt
	hidden_effect = { DA_GB_wvent_down = { g = ES } }
}
DA_GB_wgauge.ES = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_w_rigged.ES = yes check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ES value = 100 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
		DA_GB_wmishap.ES = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_w_rigged.ES = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_blew } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { 4247 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_1 } } change_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { 4247 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } change_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.regulator }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 0.85 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_GB_angry = yes }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1.25 }
		}
		change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ES which = DA_GB_rate }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ES value = 100 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ES value = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ES value = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ES value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wvc.ES check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ES value = 40 } DA_GB_wvent_price.ES = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { 4247 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } }
				add_treasury = -100
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { 4247 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } }
				add_treasury = -50
			}
			change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ES value = -40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wvh.ES check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ES value = 80 } DA_GB_wvent_price.ES = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { 4247 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } }
				add_treasury = -100
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { 4247 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } }
				add_treasury = -50
			}
			change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ES value = -40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ES value = 100 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ES value = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ES value = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ES value = 0 }
		}
		DA_GB_wzone = { g = ES }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ES value = 100 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.ES } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.ES } }
				random_list = {
					1 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.ES = yes
					}
					999 = {
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.ES }
				random_list = {
					10 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.ES = yes
					}
					990 = {
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.ES }
				random_list = {
					30 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.ES = yes
					}
					970 = {
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

DA_GB_rig_done.OT = {
	if = {
		limit = { owns = 526 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_t1.OT }
			526 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Drowned_Arsenal tier = 1 } set_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_1 }
			DA_OT_sync = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_t2.OT }
			526 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Drowned_Arsenal tier = 1 } set_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 }
			DA_OT_sync = yes
		}
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_OT value = 0 }
		DA_GB_wzone = { g = OT }
	}
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_rigging.OT
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_t1.OT
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_t2.OT
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_busy
	DA_GB_refresh = yes
}
DA_GB_wvent.OT = {
	if = {
		limit = { 526 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } }
		add_treasury = -100
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { 526 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } }
		add_treasury = -50
	}
	custom_tooltip = DA_GB_vent_tt
	hidden_effect = { DA_GB_wvent_down = { g = OT } }
}
DA_GB_wgauge.OT = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_w_rigged.OT = yes check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_OT value = 100 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
		DA_GB_wmishap.OT = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_w_rigged.OT = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_blew } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { 526 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_1 } } change_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { 526 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } change_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.regulator }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 0.85 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_GB_angry = yes }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1.25 }
		}
		change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_OT which = DA_GB_rate }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_OT value = 100 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_OT value = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_OT value = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_OT value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wvc.OT check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_OT value = 40 } DA_GB_wvent_price.OT = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { 526 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } }
				add_treasury = -100
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { 526 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } }
				add_treasury = -50
			}
			change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_OT value = -40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wvh.OT check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_OT value = 80 } DA_GB_wvent_price.OT = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { 526 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } }
				add_treasury = -100
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { 526 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } }
				add_treasury = -50
			}
			change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_OT value = -40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_OT value = 100 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_OT value = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_OT value = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_OT value = 0 }
		}
		DA_GB_wzone = { g = OT }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_OT value = 100 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.OT } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.OT } }
				random_list = {
					1 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.OT = yes
					}
					999 = {
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.OT }
				random_list = {
					10 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.OT = yes
					}
					990 = {
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.OT }
				random_list = {
					30 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.OT = yes
					}
					970 = {
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

}

DA_GB_wgauge.ST = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_w_rigged.ST = yes check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ST value = 100 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
		DA_GB_wmishap.ST = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_w_rigged.ST = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_blew } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { 4266 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_1 } } change_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { 4266 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } change_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.regulator }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 0.85 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_GB_angry = yes }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1.25 }
		}
		change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ST which = DA_GB_rate }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ST value = 100 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ST value = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ST value = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ST value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wvc.ST check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ST value = 40 } DA_GB_wvent_price.ST = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { 4266 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } }
				add_treasury = -100
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { 4266 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } }
				add_treasury = -50
			}
			change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ST value = -40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wvh.ST check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ST value = 80 } DA_GB_wvent_price.ST = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { 4266 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } }
				add_treasury = -100
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { 4266 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } }
				add_treasury = -50
			}
			change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ST value = -40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ST value = 100 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ST value = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ST value = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ST value = 0 }
		}
		DA_GB_wzone = { g = ST }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_ST value = 100 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.ST } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.ST } }
				random_list = {
					1 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.ST = yes
					}
					999 = {
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.ST }
				random_list = {
					10 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.ST = yes
					}
					990 = {
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.ST }
				random_list = {
					30 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.ST = yes
					}
					970 = {
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

DA_GB_rig_done.MV = {
	if = {
		limit = { owns = 2914 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_t1.MV }
			2914 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Magistrates_Vault tier = 1 } set_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_1 }
			DA_MV_sync = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_t2.MV }
			2914 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Magistrates_Vault tier = 1 } set_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 }
			DA_MV_sync = yes
		}
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MV value = 0 }
		DA_GB_wzone = { g = MV }
	}
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_rigging.MV
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_t1.MV
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_t2.MV
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_busy
	DA_GB_refresh = yes
}
DA_GB_wvent.MV = {

		add_treasury = -100
	}

	hidden_effect = { DA_GB_wvent_down = { g = MV } }
}
DA_GB_wgauge.MV = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_w_rigged.MV = yes check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MV value = 100 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_blew
		DA_GB_wmishap.MV = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_w_rigged.MV = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_blew } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { 2914 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_1 } } change_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { 2914 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } change_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.regulator }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 0.85 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_GB_angry = yes }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_rate value = 1.25 }
		}
		change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MV which = DA_GB_rate }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MV value = 100 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MV value = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MV value = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MV value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wvc.MV check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MV value = 40 } DA_GB_wvent_price.MV = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { 2914 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } }
				add_treasury = -100
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { 2914 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } }
				add_treasury = -50
			}
			change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MV value = -40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wvh.MV check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MV value = 80 } DA_GB_wvent_price.MV = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { 2914 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } }
				add_treasury = -100
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { 2914 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } } }
				add_treasury = -50
			}
			change_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MV value = -40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MV value = 100 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MV value = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MV value = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MV value = 0 }
		}
		DA_GB_wzone = { g = MV }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_MV value = 100 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.MV } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.MV } }
				random_list = {
					1 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.MV = yes
					}
					999 = {
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.MV }
				random_list = {
					10 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.MV = yes
					}
					990 = {
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.MV }
				random_list = {
					30 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0.8 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
						modifier = { factor = 0.7 DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
						DA_GB_wmishap.MV = yes
					}
					970 = {
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 11 }
				DA_GB_wzone = { g = HV }
			}
			350 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep value = 116 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_HV value = 0 }
				add_army_professionalism = -0.05
				4311 = { DA_GB_make_crater = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { has_estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses }
					add_estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses loyalty = -5 }
				}
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 12 }
				DA_GB_wzone = { g = HV }
			}
			100 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep value = 116 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_HV value = 0 }
				change_innovativeness = 3
				DA_GB_advance = { share = 0.05 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses }
					add_estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses loyalty = 5 }
				}
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 13 }
				DA_GB_wzone = { g = HV }
			}
			50 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep value = 116 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_HV value = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { 4311 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } }
					set_country_flag = DA_GB_fell
					4311 = { clr_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Hall_of_Vanguard tier = -1 } }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_fell } 4311 = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_1 } }
					4311 = { clr_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_1 add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Hall_of_Vanguard tier = -1 } }
				}
				clr_country_flag = DA_GB_fell
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 14 }
				DA_GB_wzone = { g = HV }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Controlled }
		random_list = {
			294 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep value = 116 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_HV value = 0 }
				add_army_professionalism = -0.05
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 11 }
				DA_GB_wzone = { g = HV }
			}
			206 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep value = 116 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_HV value = 0 }
				add_army_professionalism = -0.05
				4311 = { DA_GB_make_crater = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { has_estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses }
					add_estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses loyalty = -5 }
				}
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 12 }
				DA_GB_wzone = { g = HV }
			}
			500 = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep value = 116 }
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wp_HV value = 0 }
				change_innovativeness = 3
				DA_GB_advance = { share = 0.05 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses }
					add_estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses loyalty = 5 }
				}
				set_variable = { which = DA_GB_rep_kind value = 13 }
				DA_GB_wzone = { g = HV }
			}
		}
	}
	DA_GB_report = yes
}

# Vent All (the red valve wheel): every gauge at Hot or above, while the treasury pays.
DA_GB_vent_all = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_GB_vent_all_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.stills OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.stills has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.stills } treasury = 25 }
			add_treasury = -25
			DA_GB_vent_down = { g = stills }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.pumps OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.pumps has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.pumps } treasury = 25 }
			add_treasury = -25
			DA_GB_vent_down = { g = pumps }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.market OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.market has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.market } treasury = 25 }
			add_treasury = -25
			DA_GB_vent_down = { g = market }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.conveyor OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.conveyor has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.conveyor } treasury = 50 }
			add_treasury = -50
			DA_GB_vent_down = { g = conveyor }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.smog OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.smog has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.smog } treasury = 50 }
			add_treasury = -50
			DA_GB_vent_down = { g = smog }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.quarries OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.quarries has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.quarries } treasury = 75 }
			add_treasury = -75
			DA_GB_vent_down = { g = quarries }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.rumour OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.rumour has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.rumour } treasury = 25 }
			add_treasury = -25
			DA_GB_vent_down = { g = rumour }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.telegraph OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.telegraph has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.telegraph } treasury = 25 }
			add_treasury = -25
			DA_GB_vent_down = { g = telegraph }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.lectures OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.lectures has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.lectures } treasury = 25 }
			add_treasury = -25
			DA_GB_vent_down = { g = lectures }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.clock OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.clock has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.clock } treasury = 50 }
			add_treasury = -50
			DA_GB_vent_down = { g = clock }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.stealth OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.stealth has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.stealth } treasury = 50 }
			add_treasury = -50
			DA_GB_vent_down = { g = stealth }
		}
		if = {
