		limit = { DA_GB_w_rigged.ST = yes has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.ST }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GB_red_count value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_w_rigged.SL = yes has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.SL }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GB_red_count value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_w_rigged.MV = yes has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.MV }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GB_red_count value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_w_rigged.HV = yes has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.HV }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GB_red_count value = 1 }
	}
}
# Book the running inventions on the right pool, as the Pioneers book theirs (DA_SS_reconcile_capacity); the Lab's
# capacity goes to the same pool.
DA_GB_reconcile_capacity = {
	subtract_variable = { which = ArtificeUpkeep which = DA_GB_booked_art }
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_Production_Points_Upkeep which = DA_GB_booked_prod }
	set_variable = { which = DA_GB_booked_art value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_GB_booked_prod value = 0 }
	remove_country_modifier = DA_GB_lab_art_5
	remove_country_modifier = DA_GB_lab_art_10
	remove_country_modifier = DA_GB_lab_art_15
	remove_country_modifier = DA_GB_lab_art_20
	remove_country_modifier = DA_GB_lab_art_25
	remove_country_modifier = DA_GB_lab_prod_5
	remove_country_modifier = DA_GB_lab_prod_10
	remove_country_modifier = DA_GB_lab_prod_15
	remove_country_modifier = DA_GB_lab_prod_20
	remove_country_modifier = DA_GB_lab_prod_25
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_artifice_pool = yes }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_booked_art which = DA_GB_booked }
		change_variable = { which = ArtificeUpkeep which = DA_GB_booked_art }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_lab value = 1 } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GB_lab_art_5 duration = -1 hidden = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_lab value = 2 } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GB_lab_art_10 duration = -1 hidden = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_lab value = 3 } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GB_lab_art_15 duration = -1 hidden = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_lab value = 4 } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GB_lab_art_20 duration = -1 hidden = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_lab value = 5 } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GB_lab_art_25 duration = -1 hidden = yes }
		}
		update_artifice_points = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { DA_GB_artifice_pool = yes } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_booked_prod which = DA_GB_booked }
		change_variable = { which = DA_Production_Points_Upkeep which = DA_GB_booked_prod }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_lab value = 1 } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GB_lab_prod_5 duration = -1 hidden = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_lab value = 2 } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GB_lab_prod_10 duration = -1 hidden = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_lab value = 3 } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GB_lab_prod_15 duration = -1 hidden = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_lab value = 4 } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GB_lab_prod_20 duration = -1 hidden = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_lab value = 5 } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GB_lab_prod_25 duration = -1 hidden = yes }
		}
		DA_Update_production_points = yes
	}
}
# The Lab's research speed: a living bonus of the goblin heritage (off while it is dormant).
DA_GB_lab_speed = {
	remove_country_modifier = DA_GB_lab_speed_5
	remove_country_modifier = DA_GB_lab_speed_10
	remove_country_modifier = DA_GB_lab_speed_15
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_lab value = 2 } }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GB_lab_speed_5 duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_lab value = 3 } }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GB_lab_speed_5 duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_lab value = 4 } }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GB_lab_speed_10 duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_lab value = 5 } }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GB_lab_speed_15 duration = -1 }
	}
}
# The accident chance of the danger line, as the monthly roll computes it.
DA_GB_acc_shown = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_push value = 0 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc value = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_push value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc value = 15 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_push value = 2 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc value = 60 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Shields }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc value = 0.8 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_gnome_hired = yes }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc value = 0.7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.blastwalls NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.blastwalls } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.blastwalls } }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc value = 0.85 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.blastwalls has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.blastwalls }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc value = 0.775 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.blastwalls has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.blastwalls }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc value = 0.7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_angry = yes }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc value = 1.25 }
	}
	round_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc_w which = DA_GB_acc }
	divide_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc_w value = 10 }
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc_w value = 0.45 }
	round_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc_w value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc_t which = DA_GB_acc_w }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc_t value = -10 }
	change_variable = { which = DA_GB_acc_t which = DA_GB_acc }
}
DA_GB_refresh = {
	DA_GB_machines_count = yes
	DA_GB_count = yes
	DA_GB_reconcile_capacity = yes
	DA_GB_lab_speed = yes
	DA_GB_acc_shown = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom check_variable = { which = DA_GB_lab value = 1 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_bosses
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom } }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GB_bosses
	}
}
# The racial heritage (DA_RH_sync_goblin): the Boomworks runs while the goblin heritage is primary or kept.
DA_GB_sync = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_RH_active_goblin = yes }
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_boom
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { DA_RH_active_goblin = yes } }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GB_boom
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom ai = no NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_push_set } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_push value = 1 }
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_push_set
	}
	DA_GB_refresh = yes
}

# ---- on_startup, on_primary_culture_changed, the yearly pulse ----
DA_GB_startup = {
	DA_GB_explosives = yes
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { DA_RH_active_goblin = yes has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom } }
		DA_GB_sync = yes
	}
}
# A goblin country can run the Explosives project (Boomcraft I-II of the Goblin page).
DA_GB_explosives = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_RH_primary_goblin = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_Project.Allowed.Explosive } }
		set_country_flag = DA_Project.Allowed.Explosive
	}
}
DA_GB_school_monstrous = {
	decrease_monstrous_3 = yes
}
DA_GB_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boom }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.stills NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.stills } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.stills } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.stills OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.stills has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.stills } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.conveyor NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.conveyor } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.conveyor } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.conveyor OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.conveyor has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.conveyor } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.smog NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.smog } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.smog } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.smog OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.smog has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.smog } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.pots OR = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_pots_point } had_country_flag = { flag = DA_GB_pots_point days = 1825 } } }
			clr_country_flag = DA_GB_pots_point
			set_country_flag = DA_GB_pots_point
			increase_monstrous_1 = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Genius NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_genius_ready } has_country_flag = DA_GB_genius_used had_country_flag = { flag = DA_GB_genius_used days = 3650 } }
			set_country_flag = DA_GB_genius_ready
		}
		if = {
			limit = { ai = yes NOT = { DA_AI_level_none = yes } }
			DA_GB_ai_lab = yes
			DA_GB_ai_inventions = yes
		}
		DA_GB_refresh = yes
	}
}

# ---- The window ----
DA_GB_open_boomworks = {
	set_country_flag = DA_GB_boomworks_on
	DA_GB_refresh = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GB_wsel value = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GB_wsel value = 1 }
	}
}
DA_GB_close_boomworks = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_boomworks_on
	clr_country_flag = DA_GB_guide
}

# The racial pulse (racial_heritage_data.AI_ACTIONS): one goblin tile, the Explosives project first.
DA_GB_ai_tile = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_available_research = yes DA_completed.Alchemy_1 = yes DA_yet_to_complete.Explosive = yes has_country_flag = DA_Project.Allowed.Explosive NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.explosives } }
		DA_start_research = { flag = explosives time = 96 arcane = yes unstoppable = yes }
		country_event = { id = DA_project_event.205 days = 30 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_available_research = yes DA_completed.Explosive = yes DA_completed.Steam_Power_Project = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_EPP } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = unlocked_artifice_invention_eplusplus_compound }
			DA_start_research = { flag = PR_GB_EPP time = 24 steam = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = unlocked_artifice_invention_eplusplus_compound } }
			DA_start_research = { flag = PR_GB_EPP time = 48 steam = yes }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_available_research = yes DA_PR_done.GB_EPP = yes DA_completed.Alchemy_2 = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Goblinfire } }
		DA_start_research = { flag = PR_GB_Goblinfire time = 48 steam = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_available_research = yes DA_PR_done.GB_Goblinfire = yes DA_completed.Mechanics_2 = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Wasphouses } }
		DA_start_research = { flag = PR_GB_Wasphouses time = 72 steam = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_available_research = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Assembly } }
		DA_start_research = { flag = PR_GB_Assembly time = 24 arcane = yes unstoppable = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_available_research = yes DA_PR_done.GB_Assembly = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Rats } }
		DA_start_research = { flag = PR_GB_Rats time = 36 arcane = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_available_research = yes DA_PR_done.GB_Rats = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Markets } }
		DA_start_research = { flag = PR_GB_Markets time = 36 arcane = yes }
	}
